digest.component_or_area: pytest timeout configuration and CI workflow lanes
propositions: Per-test hang budget was lowered from 300s to 20s in commit 6a5c88027c5, falling inside the band of legitimate test costs (18.7-29.93s measured on covered CI legs)
timeout_method=thread triggers os._exit(1) to kill xdist workers on expiry, producing worker crashes without Failed:Timeout verdicts, making timeout expiries invisible in logs

Thread method worker death under --dist loadgroup causes dead workers to re-dispatch pending items to respawned workers, which crash on the same item up to restart cap, amplifying job burn until timeout
The 20s budget is unmeasured for the gating ubuntu-latest py3.13 leg which adds coverage (measured 2x multiplier on test costs) and runs full suite with 4-way saturation

Patchset-only config changes to the budget are inert on the Verified gate because the gate executes workflow files from trusted main, leaving stale CLI --timeout flags in control via pytest-timeout precedence

Restore 300s budget in pyproject.toml:timeout and both _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes with --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread and add headroom contract tests verifying budget >= 2x measured worst case and <= 600s
